formattedAddress: No. 70號, Section 2, Muzha Rd, Mingyi Village, Wenshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 116

text.text:
A nice Korean restaurant with a variety of menu options to choose from, including Korean BBQ, kimchi soup, Korean pancakes, kimbap, and more! Unfortunately, we only tried two dishes, but they were both great.

Additionally, they serve an unlimited variety of side dishes. I've been to other Korean restaurants here where they only offer 3-4 kinds of side dishes. Some are only one-time served.

The restaurant's setting is good, with plenty of seating. We arrived around 7:45 PM and had to wait about 15-20 minutes for a seat.

I’d love to visit again!
